hypotheses.justification: hmp is only used in the proof, via fiveFive_of_e23 and autI_thompsonJ_eq_genD, which pass it to vHyp_of_e23. It does not appear in the conclusion. It is implied by hmin : MinParabolic H T M together with the ambient [Finite G]. The lemma CFSG.AGLEmbeddingD2.Tits.E23.minPar_of_minParabolic, in E23/MinPar.lean, has the signature `[Group G] [Finite G] {H T M} (h : MinParabolic H T M) : MinPar H T M`. I read its proof: it builds each MinPar field from hmin and uses finiteness of the subgroup lattice for the `max` field. The theorem therefore stays true with hmp removed. The proof changes by adding `have hmp := minPar_of_minParabolic hmin` at the start; the rest is unchanged. Family.lean would also need to import E23.MinPar.
